purpose: Require direct, modality-matched evidence for every user-facing input and output boundary of the VM81 playable game.
governing_invariant: Never infer user-visible success from internal execution alone, and never infer correct internal interpretation from a plausible presentation alone.
authoritative_runtime: All gameplay mutation remains exclusively governed by hhs_vm81_game_execute through the inherited HHSVM81GameRelease surface.

documented_controls.ENTER: start or restart after terminal lifecycle state

required_evidence: pseudo-terminal transport of actual documented key bytes
observed lifecycle response in the rendered terminal stream
running-frame advancement after movement and jump input

outbound.presented_modality: ANSI terminal text with a scrolling 20x18 tile viewport
required_evidence: exact UTF-8 terminal text frames emitted by the playable executable
H.264 MP4 encoded from the complete deterministic frame sequence
video frame-count, frame-rate, dimensions, duration, and nonempty-content verification

correspondence_requirements.single_presentation_formatter: Interactive play and deterministic capture shall use the same terminal-frame formatting function.
correspondence_requirements.frame_sequence: Every captured raster frame shall derive from one exact terminal text frame in canonical index order.
correspondence_requirements.replay_binding: The capture trace shall close with replay MATCH, VICTORY, two checkpoints, and 19/19 opcode coverage.
correspondence_requirements.state_binding: The evidence receipt shall preserve the final Hash72 receipt and Hash216 state identity from the authoritative run.
correspondence_requirements.environment_binding: The rasterizer, font path, font SHA-256, video codec, dimensions, frame count, frame rate, and duration shall be recorded.
correspondence_requirements.negative_rule: Missing, blank, malformed, semantically incomplete, temporally inconsistent, or unbound media shall fail release closure.

process_optimization.contract_before_implementation: Declare every claimed modality and required artifact before coding.
process_optimization.single_source_projection: Reuse the production presentation path for capture instead of building a parallel mock renderer.
process_optimization.failure_localization: Each gate shall emit its own evidence so failures identify the broken translation boundary rather than only reporting an aggregate release failure.
